title: Limensafe Scan Output Contract
description: Versioned JSON Schema for the document limensafe writes to stdout (--format json). Pins the full emitted shape — version, scan_metadata, summary, findings[] — that adopters parse (CI wrappers, jq aggregations, partner-integration). The authoritative parser discriminator is scan_metadata.output_schema_version (semver), which maps to this schema directory; the top-level `version` ("v0") is a coarse back-compat marker and scan_metadata.tool_version is the CLI build version (moves independently). Fixed objects are closed (additionalProperties:false); only the genuine count maps (by_severity, by_surface, files_skipped_by_reason) carry dynamic keys. Illustrative values use synthetic placeholders only (acme/horizon/tilden); no raw protected vocabulary appears here. See CONTRIBUTING.md §"Scan output contract".

version.description: Coarse output generation marker, retained for back-compat. Parsers should branch on scan_metadata.output_schema_version instead.

scanMetadata.description: Describes the run that produced the findings. Core counters and files_skipped_by_reason are present-with-zero/empty (never omitted/null) for stable jq/CI consumption; mode-specific fields are optional.

output_schema_version.description: Authoritative semver discriminator for the output shape; maps to the schema directory (v1.0.0).

tool_version.description: CLI build version that produced this document. Moves independently of the output contract; not a parse discriminator.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the scan began.

scan_root_kind.description: Origin of the scan root (e.g. working tree, archive). Omitted when not applicable.

git_ref.description: Redaction-safe git ref for git-surface scans. Omitted for plain filesystem scans.

visibility.description: Repo visibility scope the scan ran under.

files_scanned.description: Count of file units actually scanned.

bytes_scanned.description: Total bytes read across scanned units.

files_skipped.description: Stable total of file units NOT scanned, including files represented by directory prunes (internal-brief). A consumer reads this single integer for "how many files were not scanned" regardless of tree shape.

directories_skipped.description: Additional structural roll-up of directories pruned wholesale. Never a substitute for files_skipped — the files behind a pruned directory are also counted in files_skipped and files_skipped_by_reason.

files_skipped_by_reason.description: Reconciling breakdown of files_skipped by reason. Sums consistently with files_skipped (directory-prune-represented files are attributed to "ignored"). Present as {} when nothing was skipped.

history_blobs_scanned.description: Git-history mode only: blob units scanned. Omitted otherwise.

history_commits_scanned.description: Git-history mode only: commits walked. Omitted otherwise.

history_unique_blobs.description: Git-history mode only: unique blobs after dedup. Omitted otherwise.

catalogs_loaded.description: Per-catalog load outcome. Catalog source paths are deliberately excluded — only IDs and load status emit.

private_catalogs_status.description: Optional/private catalog posture without emitting local paths or env values. Omitted when none apply.

summary.description: Aggregate counts over detection findings only (config-warning findings are excluded from these rollups).

by_severity.description: Detection findings counted by severity. Present as {} when there are none.

by_surface.description: Detection findings counted by surface. Present as {} when there are none.

finding.description: A redaction-safe finding. Covers both detection findings and config-warning findings (which share the findings[] array). Contains no raw matched text — entity/rule/replacement IDs are alias-safe by the ID-safety rule; path and message fields are redacted before emission.

kind.description: Finding kind. Detection findings are "detection"; missing-private-catalog warnings are "config-warning".

id.description: Stable per-document finding id (e.g. f-0001, cw-0001).

fingerprint.description: Content-stable fingerprint for dedup across runs. Composition is locked in CONTRIBUTING.md + tests (a schema cannot prove a hash).

entity_id.description: Alias-safe catalog entity id. Omitted for findings without an entity (e.g. config-warning).

entity_class.description: Catalog-defined entity class (e.g. client_identity, configuration). Open string — catalog authors define classes.

detector_id.description: Detector that produced the finding (e.g. literal, regex, path-segment, co-occurrence, private-catalog-missing). Open string.

rule_id.description: Alias-safe rule id (co-occurrence and rule-driven detectors). Omitted when not rule-driven.

replacement_id.description: Alias-safe replacement marker id. Omitted when none applies.

evidence_shape.description: Shape of the evidence (e.g. literal, co_occurrence, missing_private_catalog). Open string — detector-derived and evolving.

location.description: Where the finding was observed. For non-file surfaces (branch_name, commit_message, ...) path is absent and source_id identifies the surface. All fields optional; an object with only source_id is valid.

path.description: Redaction-safe scan-root-relative path. Omitted for non-file surfaces.

source_id.description: Redaction-safe source identifier (path or synthetic surface id).

line.description: 1-based line number for file-content surfaces. Omitted when not applicable.

column.description: 1-based column for file-content surfaces. Omitted when not applicable.

git_ref.description: Redaction-safe git ref for git-surface findings. Omitted otherwise.

surface_kind.description: Concrete surface the finding was observed on.

confidence.description: v0 emits only "high"; expansion rides an output_schema_version bump.
